mentions.name: Twin tap tempo toy (Tttt)
mentions.description: A DIY MIDI clock to dual tap tempo converter device ("Twin tap tempo toy" or Tttt) built on an Arduino Esplora linked to a dual-channel optocoupler/relay. It outputs simultaneous tap tempo signals so analogue delay and tremolo pedals can be slaved to a DAW's tempo (Reaper). The software side is done; the author is troubleshooting the Arduino-to-relay connection and plans to publish the code and docs on GitHub.
mentions.problem: Off-the-shelf devices that can drive multiple analogue tap-tempo pedals simultaneously from a DAW are hard to find and expensive; only one product (Disaster Area Designs micro.clock) readily fits the need.
mentions.audience: The author, for syncing their own analogue delay and tremolo pedals to their DAW in a home music setup.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm making a midi clock -> dual tap tempo device (I'm calling it the Twin tap tempo toy, or Tttt). It's based on an Arduino Esplora linked to a dual channel optocoupler / relay.
